notes: The original sheets are composite concept boards with labels, panel frames, backgrounds, and multiple objects. They are the source of truth for visual direction.
concept-crops are rectangular reference crops from asset-sheet-02.png. They are not cleaned transparent sprites, not animation-ready sprite sheets, and not tilemap-ready tilesets.
Dimensions are pixel dimensions of the supplied image files. No resampling or cleanup was applied to the reference crops.
